# NativeTernux

**বাংলা:** Pocket-এ world-class mobile workstation তৈরির স্বাধীন project। Native Termux layer compatible tools ও Android-facing integration-এর সুযোগ দেবে; বিদ্যমান Ternux Debian PRoot layer Linux desktop, established workload ও configured GPU path দেবে। Hybrid mode দুটিকে নিরাপদ handoff দিয়ে এক workstation-এ যুক্ত করবে।

**English:** I want my phone to be a workstation I can carry in my pocket. I want native Termux and my existing Ternux PRoot setup to work together, so I can use each where it fits. Read [what I have in mind](docs/PRODUCT-VISION.md).

## Planned use

- **Native mode:** compatible Termux packages and Android-facing workflows, subject to package, API, permission, and device support.
- **Existing Ternux PRoot:** opt-in execution of selected Linux workloads in the existing Debian guest. NativeTernux will not own or clean up that desktop session.
- **Hybrid mode:** future explicit routing between those providers and verified accelerator backends, while preserving the existing Ternux PRoot feature set.

The existing [Ternux project](https://github.com/soobujmiah/ternux) remains independent. Its PRoot features remain a first-class part of the combined workstation; NativeTernux does not modify, minimize, or replace its launcher or rootfs. Native and PRoot strengths complement each other. NPU support is a research/verification gate, not yet a claim.

## Development notes

`install` has a preview-first package transaction that can install with `--yes`, but that path has not been run or qualified. Initial ownership-aware native desktop start/stop/status source is present but untested and not device-qualified; the Ternux PRoot adapter remains unimplemented. The tested native Termux Turnip package rejected Adreno 825; this does not invalidate the separately configured Ternux PRoot graphics route. See [research and evidence](docs/RESEARCH.md), [installation status](docs/INSTALLATION.md), and [PRoot GPU reuse](docs/PROOT-GPU.md).

See [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [Native/PRoot integration](docs/HYBRID-INTEGRATION.md), [Native Wine and Hangover](docs/WINE-NATIVE.md), [workload optimization](docs/OPTIMIZATION.md), [documentation and SKB sync](docs/KNOWLEDGE-SYNC.md), [Installation status](docs/INSTALLATION.md), and [AI assistant instructions](AI_ASSISTANT.md).
